data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1573 (commit 19c25d5db9, MERGED; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).

What changed:
* tests/unit/test_canonical_consolidation.py — dropped the inline `import rebar_reconciler` + `__path__.append` in `_reconciler_modules()`; docstring now points at the tests/unit/conftest.py bridge.
* tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py — same removal in `_load_outbound_differ()`; `engine_pkg` is retained since the spec load still needs it.
* tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py — AC #2 decision: KEEP it, as site-local documentation of the shadow at the directory that creates it. Added a NOTE recording that the append is no longer load-bearing (tests/unit/conftest.py already bridged by the time it runs, so it no-ops).

Evidence the shared bridge — not luck — carries these call sites:
* tests/unit/test_canonical_consolidation.py alone: 11 passed
* tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py alone: 23 passed
* both together: 34 passed
* mixed with tests/scripts/reducer: 244 passed, 1 skipped
* tests/unit/rebar_reconciler: 2392 passed
* dbb2 guard tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py: 6 passed
* An intermediate edit that removed only the `import rebar_reconciler` line while leaving the `__path__` lines produced NameError in test_code_review_artifact — confirming the tests genuinely exercise this code path rather than skipping it.
* CI ran the full suite green on ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 and macos py3.13.

make lint and make typecheck both green.
